records.label: intro
records.source: Run spaCR's command-line pipelines in a container using the published `Docker images on GHCR <https://github.com/EinarOlafsson/spacr/pkgs/container/spacr>`_. Install `Docker <https://docs.docker.com/get-started/get-docker/>`_, then list the available pipelines with this published CPU image:
records.translation: Execute os fluxos de processamento de linha de comando do spaCR em um contêiner usando as `imagens Docker publicadas no GHCR <https://github.com/EinarOlafsson/spacr/pkgs/container/spacr>`_. Instale o `Docker <https://docs.docker.com/get-started/get-docker/>`_ e liste os fluxos disponíveis com esta imagem publicada para CPU:

records.label: gpu
records.source: The matching NVIDIA GPU image is ``ghcr.io/einarolafsson/spacr:1.5.1.0-cuda12.4``. Both images target Linux x86-64 containers. See the `Docker installation guide <docs/source/installer_guide.rst#container-images>`_ for GPU prerequisites, data and model mounts, settings files, and complete pipeline commands.
records.translation: A imagem correspondente para GPU NVIDIA é ``ghcr.io/einarolafsson/spacr:1.5.1.0-cuda12.4``. Ambas as imagens são destinadas a contêineres Linux x86-64. Consulte o `guia de instalação com Docker <docs/source/installer_guide.rst#container-images>`_ para conhecer os pré-requisitos de GPU, as montagens de dados e modelos, os arquivos de configuração e os comandos completos dos fluxos de processamento.
